title: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
abstract: arXiv:2609.06396v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve the model-building machinery from its own failures, so every later model inherits the gain. Yet RSI has been validated almost exclusively on coding and formal benchmarks such as science QA and mathematics. This format bound limits RSI to improvement within a machine-checkable slice, not general capability where questions are open and correctness is settled by argument, replication, or measurement. We argue RSI must next operate across real, diverse scientific, engineering, and meta-scientific domains, not where formal evaluation is merely tractable. To that end we present MetaRSI-v1, where improvement is the scheduled composition of three typed operators over one unified paradigm. Data-RSI amplifies existing competence and marks its boundary; Harness-RSI edits a five-slot scaffold without touching weights; Model-RSI internalizes capability into parameters through bounded training. Sh

translated_title: MetaRSI / RSI2：一个针对递归自我改进系统自身的元递归自我改进系统
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）使系统能够从自身的失败中改进模型构建机制，从而使后续的每个模型都继承这一收益。然而，RSI 几乎只在编程和形式化基准（如科学问答和数学）上得到验证。这种格式限制使 RSI 只能在机器可验证的狭小范围内进行改进，而非在问题开放、正确性由论证、复现或测量来确定的通用能力领域。我们认为，RSI 下一步必须跨真实的、多样化的科学、工程和元科学领域运行，而不能局限于形式化评估仅仅可行的地方。为此，我们提出了 MetaRSI-v1，其中改进是在统一范式下三个类型化算子的按计划组合：Data-RSI 放大现有能力并标记其边界；Harness-RSI 在不触及权重的情况下编辑五槽支架；Model-RSI 通过有界训练将能力内化到模型参数中。
tldr: 该论文提出 MetaRSI-v1 系统，通过 Data-RSI、Harness-RSI 和 Model-RSI 三个算子的统一组合，将递归自我改进从机器可验证的编程与数学基准扩展到真实的科学、工程和元科学等开放性领域。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MetaRSI-v1, which extends recursive self-improvement beyond machine-checkable coding and math benchmarks to real scientific, engineering, and meta-scientific domains through the scheduled composition of three typed operators: Data-RSI, Harness-RSI, and Model-RSI.
